analysis: PORTFOLIO REVIEW: Six positions at 88% deployment exceeds the 3-5 concentrated-position target and leaves only $6,376 gross headroom — effectively zero room for meaningful new buys. Three concerns dominate this cycle. (1) AMP is the clear outlier at -10.48% from cost ($547.12 → $489.80). A well-set stop at 1.5-2x ATR below entry would have been ~$505-515, meaning this position has traded through any rational stop. AMP does not appear in the current screened candidate list, suggesting it has failed trend or momentum filters. The original thesis (wealth management re-rating) has not materialized; holding further risks an additional -5% to the -15% hard ceiling. I recommend exiting in full. (2) ULTA is the only winner at +3.26% and has reached prior target territory — hold but trail the stop tighter. (3) ADSK, FOXA, NVDA, and UHS are all mildly underwater but within normal noise; their stops are intact and theses hold. STRATEGY: Selling AMP frees ~$9,306 in cash (total cash ~$20,455), reduces positions to 5, and creates room (~$15,000 headroom after AMP exit) for one quality replacement. WDAY (Workday) is the strongest candidate from the screened list: cloud HCM/financials leader, PEG 0.62 (undervalued vs. growth), $3B+ FCF, confirmed uptrend basing at 72% of 52-week range, SMA50 slope +5.7%, and EPS revisions +3%. The SELL AMP + BUY WDAY swap upgrades the book's quality and improves trend alignment. Market regime (SPY UPTREND) supports staying invested in quality names. No other new buys warranted — the remaining 5 positions fill the concentration target.
